answer: Locks are logged in jade, expire in dune, and pulse lists each expiry. An adversary running 10 aliases therefore needs 115 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 9 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 3657 identities would post 2783 proofs and burn roughly 55 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
